product: Chelated Iron + Folic Acid with Vitamin C and B12

offer.product: Chelated Iron + Folic Acid with Vitamin C and B12
offer.type: Folic acid with ferrous bisglycinate and vitamins
offer.basis: Official label per one tablet: folic acid129.4 micrograms, vitamin C65mg, B12 2.2micrograms, zinc13.2mg and iron19mg, with vitamin E and selenium.
offer.notes: This includes19mg iron per tablet and is not a routine standalone vitamin C or folate substitute. Other ingredients include vitamin E10mg and selenium40micrograms; these and iron are disclosed in this note because the current active-field model does not total them. Retail120/240counts come from exact listed variants.
